in_marathi.name: Ashwath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Horse, Vehicle of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashwath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashwath is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ashva' meaning 'horse'. This name is believed to be the vehicle of the gods and is often associated with strength, power, and divine blessings. In Hindu mythology, the Ashvins are a pair of divine twins who are the gods of healing, herbs, horses, and the sky.
